instruction:
You are a civil stormwater engineer checking a task-owned synthetic stormwater water-quality, pollutant-load, and construction sediment package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Construction sediment basin sizing, pollutant load estimation, temporary discharge review, and stormwater water-quality workflows shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product family: `SSC-03-LH-06`
- Construction staging plan: `STAGE-SSC03-006`
- Catchment table: `CATCH-SSC03-006`
- Pollutant concentration basis: `POLLUT-SSC03-006`
- Sediment basin sketch: `BASIN-SSC03-006`
- Environmental control memo: `MEMO-SSC03-006`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Disturbed area | {{ disturbed_area_ha }} ha |
| Runoff depth | {{ runoff_depth_mm }} mm |
| Pollutant concentration | {{ pollutant_concentration_mg_l }} mg/L |
| Removal efficiency | {{ removal_efficiency }} |
| Sediment basin volume | {{ sediment_basin_volume_m3 }} m3 |
| Required volume per hectare | {{ required_volume_per_ha_m3 }} m3/ha |
| Dewatering flow | {{ dewatering_flow_l_s }} L/s |
| Temporary channel capacity | {{ temporary_channel_capacity_l_s }} L/s |
| Weir discharge coefficient | {{ weir_discharge_coefficient }} |
| Outlet weir length | {{ outlet_weir_length_m }} m |
| Outlet weir head | {{ outlet_weir_head_m }} m |
| Target capture | {{ target_capture_percent }} percent |

## Checks

- Runoff volume equals disturbed area times runoff depth.
- Pollutant load equals runoff volume times pollutant concentration with unit conversion.
- Required basin volume equals disturbed area times required volume per hectare.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when basin volume, temporary discharge, and capture checks pass; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the object IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated SWMM report-output evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "runoff_volume_m3": <numeric_value>,
  "pollutant_load_kg": <numeric_value>,
  "removed_load_kg": <numeric_value>,
  "residual_load_kg": <numeric_value>,
  "required_basin_volume_m3": <numeric_value>,
  "basin_volume_margin_m3": <numeric_value>,
  "temporary_discharge_margin_l_s": <numeric_value>,
  "weir_release_l_s": <numeric_value>,
  "capture_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "capture_margin_percent": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
# ABOUTME: Defines the stormwater water-quality pollutant-load construction sediment template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one synthetic construction staging, pollutant, basin, and discharge source package.

[meta]
name = "water-quality-pollutant-load-construction-sediment-package"
description = "stormwater construction runoff, pollutant load, sediment basin, and discharge metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound water-quality and construction sediment metrics from a deterministic stormwater task-owned source pack. The template combines runoff volume, pollutant load, removed and residual load, sediment basin volume, temporary discharge capacity, weir release, capture percentage, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "civil"
category = "water-quality-sediment"
standards = ["construction sediment basin sizing", "pollutant load estimation", "temporary discharge review", "stormwater water-quality workflows"]
tags = ["civil", "stormwater", "water-quality", "sediment", "construction", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.disturbed_area_ha]
type = "float"
unit = "ha"
description = "STAGE-SSC03-006 disturbed construction area"
min = 2.4
max = 2.4

[params.runoff_depth_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "CATCH-SSC03-006 runoff depth"
min = 38.0
max = 38.0

[params.pollutant_concentration_mg_l]
type = "float"
unit = "mg/L"
description = "POLLUT-SSC03-006 event mean pollutant concentration"
min = 180.0
max = 180.0

[params.removal_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "BASIN-SSC03-006 sediment basin removal efficiency"
min = 0.78
max = 0.78

[params.sediment_basin_volume_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3"
description = "BASIN-SSC03-006 available sediment basin volume"
min = 920.0
max = 920.0

[params.required_volume_per_ha_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/ha"
description = "MEMO-SSC03-006 required basin volume per disturbed hectare"
min = 320.0
max = 320.0

[params.dewatering_flow_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "STAGE-SSC03-006 temporary dewatering flow"
min = 42.0
max = 42.0

[params.temporary_channel_capacity_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "BASIN-SSC03-006 temporary discharge channel capacity"
min = 65.0
max = 65.0

[params.weir_discharge_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "BASIN-SSC03-006 outlet weir coefficient"
min = 1.7
max = 1.7

[params.outlet_weir_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "BASIN-SSC03-006 outlet weir length"
min = 1.8
max = 1.8

[params.outlet_weir_head_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "BASIN-SSC03-006 outlet weir head"
min = 0.22
max = 0.22

[params.target_capture_percent]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "MEMO-SSC03-006 target pollutant capture"
min = 75.0
max = 75.0

[outputs.runoff_volume_m3]
description = "Construction-stage runoff volume"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pollutant_load_kg]
description = "Pollutant load entering the sediment basin"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.removed_load_kg]
description = "Pollutant load removed by the sediment basin"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.residual_load_kg]
description = "Residual pollutant load after removal"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.required_basin_volume_m3]
description = "Required basin volume"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.basin_volume_margin_m3]
description = "Available basin volume minus required basin volume"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.temporary_discharge_margin_l_s]
description = "Temporary channel capacity minus dewatering flow"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.weir_release_l_s]
description = "Outlet weir release capacity"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.capture_percent]
description = "Pollutant capture percentage"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.capture_margin_percent]
description = "Capture percentage minus target capture"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "Pass score for basin volume, discharge, and capture checks"
tolerance = 0.03

[archetypes.stormwater_water_quality_sediment_case]
description = "Water-quality pollutant-load and construction sediment case"
disturbed_area_ha = {min = 2.4, max = 2.4}
runoff_depth_mm = {min = 38.0, max = 38.0}
pollutant_concentration_mg_l = {min = 180.0, max = 180.0}
removal_efficiency = {min = 0.78, max = 0.78}
sediment_basin_volume_m3 = {min = 920.0, max = 920.0}
required_volume_per_ha_m3 = {min = 320.0, max = 320.0}
dewatering_flow_l_s = {min = 42.0, max = 42.0}
temporary_channel_capacity_l_s = {min = 65.0, max = 65.0}
weir_discharge_coefficient = {min = 1.7, max = 1.7}
outlet_weir_length_m = {min = 1.8, max = 1.8}
outlet_weir_head_m = {min = 0.22, max = 0.22}
target_capture_percent = {min = 75.0, max = 75.0}
site_contexts = ["construction-sediment", "water-quality-check"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All source-pack values given for the stormwater water-quality sediment package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["stormwater_water_quality_sediment_case"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All source-pack values given for the stormwater water-quality sediment package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["stormwater_water_quality_sediment_case"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "All source-pack values given for the stormwater water-quality sediment package"
